## v5.2.0 Summary

### User-facing changes
- Added GitHub Release update awareness through CBXShell Manager.
- Added a manual **Check for Updates** action in the manager Tools menu.
- Added per-user background update checks with a local cache so Explorer remains network-free.
- Improved installer upgrade behavior by removing forced pre-uninstall and relying on overwrite install semantics.

### Runtime and reliability changes
- Kept archive and image format support intact while restructuring build boundaries for better incremental reuse.
- Refined image pipeline boundaries to reduce dirty rebuild tails for magic, thumbnail, and decode changes.
- Kept CBXManager installed as a required component so update checks are always available.

### Distribution notes
- GitHub Releases with NSIS installers remain the primary supported delivery channel.
- Chocolatey and WinGet remain optional release-ops channels and are not used by the in-app updater.
